$what_the_vectors_are_not: A GOLDEN. Aeon has not built the generator half of regions part 2, so no generated artifact exists to compare against and nothing in this repo claims one does. They are also not existence vectors: the vectors' own $comment lists what is deliberately absent, and it is the same list the schema's description gives.
